Render one book or presentation in the folder of the pkgdown site

Source: R/render_site_item.R
render_site_item.Rd

Renders item where build_site() would render it: a book in <site>/<subdir_reports>/<book>/, a presentation in <site>/<subdir_presentations>/<name>/. It is meant for a CI job that renders each book and presentation on its own, at the same time as the others (see update_gitlab_ci()). A last job then builds the site with build_site(render_reports = FALSE, render_presentations = FALSE, check_rendered = TRUE).

Usage

render_site_item(
  item,
  path_site = "public",
  path_reports = "reports",
  path_presentations = "presentations",
  subdir_reports = "reports",
  subdir_presentations = "presentations",
  output_format = NULL,
  clean = TRUE
)

Arguments

item

Folder of the book or presentation, e.g. "reports/01_first_fr" or "presentations/seminar". An item that does not exist is skipped with a message: the matrix of the CI lists the items of several branches, see update_gitlab_ci().

path_site

Folder of the pkgdown site, see build_site().

path_reports, path_presentations

Folders containing the books and the presentations.

subdir_reports, subdir_presentations

Folders of the site where each book and presentation is rendered in its own sub-folder.

output_format

Formats rendered in addition to the HTML, see build_site() (each format runs the code of the chapters again).

clean

Whether to remove the previous output of the item in the site before rendering.

Value

The folder of the item in the site, invisibly (NULL if the item does not exist).

Details

The HTML is always rendered, like in build_site(), and so are the formats of output_format that the item declares. The site of a development version (pkgdown development: mode, or the environment variable PKGDOWN_DEV_MODE) is <path_site>/dev.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
render_site_item("reports/01_first_fr")
} # }
